# BioPython Cheat Sheet {#sec-biopython}

## Installation

```bash
pip install biopython
```

## Reading Sequences

```{python}
#| eval: false
from Bio import SeqIO

# Read a single FASTA record
record = SeqIO.read("sequence.fasta", "fasta")
print(record.id)           # Sequence ID
print(record.description)  # Full description
print(record.seq)          # The sequence
print(len(record.seq))     # Length

# Read multiple records
for record in SeqIO.parse("sequences.fasta", "fasta"):
    print(f"{record.id}: {len(record.seq)} bp")

# Read GenBank
record = SeqIO.read("sequence.gb", "genbank")
print(record.features)     # List of features
print(record.annotations)  # Metadata
```

## Writing Sequences

```{python}
#| eval: false
from Bio.SeqRecord import SeqRecord
from Bio.Seq import Seq

# Create a record
record = SeqRecord(
    Seq("ATGCGATCGATCG"),
    id="seq001",
    description="example sequence"
)

# Write to FASTA
SeqIO.write([record], "output.fasta", "fasta")

# Write to GenBank
SeqIO.write([record], "output.gb", "genbank")
```

## Sequence Operations

```{python}
#| eval: false
from Bio.Seq import Seq

dna = Seq("ATGCGATCG")

# Complement
dna.complement()        # "TAGCTAGC"

# Reverse complement
dna.reverse_complement()  # "CGATCGCAT"

# Transcription (DNA to RNA)
rna = dna.transcribe()  # "AUGCGAUCG"

# Translation (DNA to protein)
protein = dna.translate()  # "MR*"

# Translate with specific table
protein = dna.translate(table=1)  # Standard genetic code

# Find open reading frames
for strand, seq in [(+1, dna), (-1, dna.reverse_complement())]:
    for frame in range(3):
        trans = seq[frame:].translate()
        print(f"Frame {frame} {'+' if strand == 1 else '-'}: {trans}")
```

## BLAST Search

```{python}
#| eval: false
from Bio.Blast import NCBIWWW
from Bio.Blast import NCBIXML

# Run BLAST online
result = NCBIWWW.qblast("blastn", "nt", "ATGCGATCGATCG")

# Parse results
blast_records = NCBIXML.parse(result)
for record in blast_records:
    for alignment in record.alignments:
        for hsp in alignment.hsps:
            print(f"Sequence: {alignment.title}")
            print(f"Score: {hsp.score}")
            print(f"E-value: {hsp.expect}")
            print(f"Identity: {hsp.identities}/{hsp.align_length}")
```

## Entrez (NCBI Database Access)

```{python}
#| eval: false
from Bio import Entrez

Entrez.email = "your.email@example.com"

# Search
handle = Entrez.esearch(db="nucleotide", term="BRCA1 human")
record = Entrez.read(handle)
print(f"Found {record['Count']} results")
print(f"IDs: {record['IdList'][:5]}")

# Fetch
handle = Entrez.efetch(db="nucleotide", id="NM_007294", rettype="fasta")
print(handle.read())

# Fetch GenBank
handle = Entrez.efetch(db="nucleotide", id="NM_007294", rettype="gb")
record = SeqIO.read(handle, "genbank")
```

## Alignment

```{python}
#| eval: false
from Bio import pairwise2
from Bio.pairwise2 import format_alignment

# Global alignment
alignments = pairwise2.align.globalxx("ATGCG", "ATGAG")

# Print best alignment
print(format_alignment(*alignments[0]))

# Local alignment
alignments = pairwise2.align.localxx("ATGCG", "ATGAG")
```

## Restriction Enzymes

```{python}
#| eval: false
from Bio import Restriction

# Get a restriction enzyme
ecoRI = Restriction.EcoRI
print(f"Recognition site: {ecoRI.site}")  # "GAATTC"

# Find cut sites in a sequence
from Bio.Seq import Seq
dna = Seq("ATGCGAATTCGATCG")
sites = ecoRI.search(dna)
print(f"Cut sites: {sites}")  # [5]

# List all available enzymes
print(dir(Restriction))
```

## Working with PDB Files

```{python}
#| eval: false
from Bio.PDB import PDBParser

parser = PDBParser(QUIET=True)
structure = parser.get_structure("1TUP", "1TUP.pdb")

# Iterate over atoms
for model in structure:
    for chain in model:
        for residue in chain:
            for atom in residue:
                print(atom.name, atom.coord)

# Get sequence from PDB
from Bio.PDB import PPBuilder
ppb = PPBuilder()
for pp in ppb.build_peptides(structure):
    print(pp.get_sequence())
```
